meta.title: LabVIEW MCP (unofficial)
meta.description: An unofficial DSH bundle for Zuehlke's LabVIEW MCP server. It provisions the Windows x64 runtime on first use (about 57 MB download), then registers 122 LabVIEW MCP tools; expect about 65–75k tokens per request, and Windows x64 is required. Disable it in Plugins to remove the tools from new sessions. When mcp__labview__* tools are missing, check the native labview_mcp_status and labview_mcp_repair diagnostics first.
